title: FileGrix: Ultimate File Viewer, Editor & Converter
description: View, search, edit and export PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, Markdown, EPUB, archives, SQLite, Parquet and notebooks in your editor. Send any selection to the AI agent you already use, and give agents safe tools and an MCP server to read your documents. Offline, no telemetry.

title: MultiKolay
description: MultiKolay temaları için Liquid dil desteği, canlı denetim ve mağaza kısayolları

title: EG
description: Launch eg workloads locally and open VS Code inside them.

title: Markdown Alerts
description: Renders GitHub Alert callouts in VS Code's Markdown Preview and exported .htmd documents, with automatic theme detection and Markdown stylesheet overrides.

title: Markdown Stylesheets
description: Provides custom Markdown preview and export styling with a fixed-width centered layout, horizontally scrollable tables, blockquotes, and code blocks with a copy-to-clipboard button, plus switchable GitHub and VS Code themes.

title: Query Check for Browserslist
description: Check .browserslistrc and package.json "browserslist" queries as you type: invalid queries, queries that select nothing, lines that add nothing, the browsers each line selects, coverage, completion and highlighting. Works offline.

title: Test Explorer for QUnit
description: Run and debug QUnit tests (Node.js CLI) from the VS Code Testing view and the editor gutter: nested modules, test.each, skip/todo, and expected/actual diffs at the failing line.

title: Markdown HTMD Exports
description: Exports Markdown files (.md) to self-contained Markdown HTMD files (.htmd) which open automatically in VS Code's built-in viewer and your default web browser.

title: Checks for Python MANIFEST.in
description: Finds mistakes in setuptools MANIFEST.in files: unknown commands, wrong arguments and lines that match no files, with hovers that list the files each line adds or removes, using setuptools' own matching rules.

title: Thread Trace — Agent Blame
description: Hover a line to see which agent, model and prompt wrote it.

title: Markdown HTMD Exports for Antigravity
description: Keeps exported .htmd files in sync automatically when Google Antigravity agents edit Markdown files, building on top of Markdown HTMD Exports.
